evidence_summary: CyberX's official site describes the company as a digital asset trading, infrastructure, and market-making firm. It explicitly advertises exchange market making with real-time HFT algos and low-latency infrastructure, algorithmic market making across 30+ liquidity venues, decentralized liquidity provision and a DeFi AMM, on-chain execution, and DeFi protocol connectivity. Its Strategies page offers Block Trades using TWAP/VWAP/PEG algorithms, connection to top liquidity venues, 24/7 quotes, minimum slippage, and high-touch trading support. Its Labs page says it supports portfolio companies with market making and OTC transactions. I found no explicit sub-fund, feeder, umbrella, parallel fund, SPV, fund platform, or fund-of-funds evidence.
yes_boundaries: otc_trading crosses the threshold because CyberX explicitly offers Block Trades and says CyberX Labs supports OTC transactions.
algorithm_trading crosses the threshold because CyberX explicitly describes real-time HFT algos, low-latency infrastructure, algorithmic market making, and TWAP/VWAP/PEG trading algorithms.
market_making crosses the threshold because CyberX explicitly calls itself a market maker and advertises low-latency market making and liquidity provision.

execution_services crosses the threshold because CyberX explicitly offers block trade execution support, connection to top liquidity venues, on-chain execution, quotes, slippage reduction, and trading support.
defi crosses the threshold because CyberX itself advertises decentralized liquidity provision, a DeFi AMM, DeFi capabilities, DeFi data analytics, on-chain execution, and DeFi protocol connectivity.
no_boundaries: No sub_fund evidence was found; CyberX Labs' venture investment activity is not evidence of a sub-fund, feeder, umbrella, parallel fund, SPV, fund platform, or fund-of-funds structure.
